description: This file contains unit tests for the ComparableCache class, testing its behavior with different key-value update scenarios.

classes.name: ComparableCacheTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ComparableCache implementation.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize the ComparableCache instance before each test.

methods.name: getOnNonExistingKeyReturnsNull
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a non-existing key returns null.

methods.name: initialUpdateAndGet
methods.description: Tests initial update and retrieval behavior of the cache.

methods.name: updateWithLowerValue
methods.description: Tests that updating with a lower value does not change the cache and returns false.

methods.name: updateWithSameValue
methods.description: Tests that updating with the same value does not change the cache and returns false.

methods.name: updateWithHigherValue
methods.description: Tests that updating with a higher value updates the cache and returns true.
